snippet.title: Horse Runner DX - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist / Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955320/Horse_Runner_DX/ 🦄

ABOUT THIS GAME:
Lead your herd. Survive the chaos. Grow and guide your ever-expanding horse herd in this fast-paced arcade roguelite runner. Stack unique power-ups, master the trail, and push your limits in addictive high-score runs to climb the global leaderboard.

KEY FEATURES:
- Arcade Roguelite Action: No two runs are the same.
- Strategic Herd-Building: Every horse adds a power-up.
- Global Leaderboard: Compete against the world for the top spot.
- Steam Deck Optimized: Perfect for quick, addictive runs on the go.

#HorseRunnerDX #Roguelite #IndieGame #PixelArt #Arcade #SteamDeck
